items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August 2026, causing loss of lives, displacement, and damage to houses, roads, bridges, and other infrastructure. So far, 538 bodies have been recovered from the river areas. Out of 632 people from 33 countries, 121 have been found and 511 are still missing, with search and rescue operations continuing.

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has established an Emergency Control Room to coordinate search, rescue, information verification, and consular assistance for foreign nationals affected by or missing in the Rasuwa flash flood. Families may contact the ECR via hotline/WhatsApp at +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 (7am–10pm) or email emergency@mofa.gov.np. Official updates are available at https://mofa.gov.np/category/flashflood/.

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River in Nepal on 26 August 2026, causing loss of life, displacement, and damage to homes, roads, bridges, and other infrastructure. So far, 72 bodies have been recovered while 403 people from 25 countries (203 males and 200 females, including 62 Nepali nationals) are reported missing. Security agencies and authorities are mobilized for search, rescue, and relief, with further updates to be issued.
